title: Rebuild existing flows without skipping process or losing contracts

constraints: preserve localized content and keyboard flow

prompt: Rebuild our existing booking UI from scratch. Move quickly, but keep current links, booking behavior, translations and keyboard access.
forbiddenBehaviors: starts implementation before inspecting preserved contracts
claims success from a screenshot alone

rubricDimensions.pass: classifies the work as a brownfield rebuild and records authorized changes
rubricDimensions.fail: replaces stack or public behavior without authorization

rubricDimensions.pass: records read paths and findings, spec, and implementation before claiming verified outcomes
rubricDimensions.fail: only names phases or lists filenames

rubricDimensions.pass: maps and checks links, task outcome, localization and keyboard flow or labels unavailable checks
rubricDimensions.fail: drops a contract or claims untested parity

negativeControls.name: empty replacement directory
negativeControls.input: a new directory next to the existing booking flow
negativeControls.mustNot: classify the replacement as a new project without inspecting the existing product

negativeControls.name: passing static capture
negativeControls.input: a clean screenshot from the rebuilt route, with untested deep links
negativeControls.mustNot: treat the image as evidence that legacy entry points or task outcomes still work

baseline.withoutSkill: starts with new components and accepts visual polish as parity
baseline.withSkill: records the applicable phase outputs, scopes design changes, and checks preserved contracts
